title: DispatchResponse
description:
`GET /v1/sandboxes/{id}/dispatch/{date}`, staff only, and the answer to every dispatch
command: one bakery day's stops and plans. It mirrors the Dispatch aggregate's state.

capacity.description: Units a van carries: the last proposal's, 250 before any.

comparison.description:
Both plans' totals, when there are both; `null` while the browser's solver has not run
or cannot (the page then shows the server's plan alone and says why).

plan_v.description: The published plan's version, 0 before the first publish.

proposed.description: The server's plan from the last `propose`.

published.description: The record: what drivers, the kitchen board and the order status read.

stops.description: Every stop the day has seen, removed ones included, by order ULID.

submitted.description: The browser's plan from the last `plan`, validated.

vans.description: The day's vans, 1 to 4: the last proposal's, 4 before any.

ComparisonView.description: The two plans' totals side by side.

gap_percent.description:
`(server − browser) / browser × 100`, to one decimal: positive when the heuristic drives
longer. `null` when the browser's plan drives 0 minutes and the server's does not.

PlanSource.description: Who made a plan: the server's savings heuristic or the browser's VROOM solver.

PlanView.description:
A plan as the dispatch screen shows it (ADR 0012, decision 5). Its minutes are the server's
own arithmetic over the matrix, whoever made the plan.

last_back.description:
When the last van is back, a business time: the vans leave at 09:00 and drive the
matrix's minutes, with no time at the door counted.

plan_v.description:
A published plan's version. A proposal or submission carries the version it would be
published as when it was made; one at or below the response's `plan_v` is stale.

unassigned.description: Order ULIDs no van could take. A plan with any cannot be published.

vans.description: The vans used, by van; a plan may use fewer than the day has.

StopStatus.description: Where a delivery stop stands (ADR 0012; docs/domain.md, "Ubiquitous language": Stop).

oneOf.description: Placed, not yet paid: shown, in no plan.
Paid: every plan must carry it.

customer.description: The customer's ULID; the screen shows the persona's made-up address, never the place.

order.description: The order's ULID: what every plan names the stop by.

place.description: The customer's place, an index into the travel-time matrix, 0 to 63.

stop.description:
The stop's number in the published plan, counted from 1 across the vans, van 1's stops
first; `null` when it is in no published plan.

units.description: The order's line quantities summed: what the stop takes of a van's capacity.

van.description: The van that carries it in the published plan; `null` when none does.

window.description: The delivery window's start, a business time.

minutes.description: The drive, bakery to bakery, from the travel-time matrix.

units.description: The stops' units summed; never over the day's capacity.
